title: A Generalizable Rhetorical Strategy Annotation Model Using LLM-based Debate Simulation and Labelling
reasoning: The paper explicitly defines and evaluates 'Moral' as one of its four core rhetorical strategy categories. It defines this category through concepts of right and wrong, justice, virtue, and duty (deontology). Furthermore, the study utilizes specific datasets related to moral reasoning and ethics, such as 'Ethixs' and 'Moral-Emotions', for validation and training.
